## Project-Wide Conventions
### File-header Convention Per `AX_FILE_HEADER_TASK_TRACEABILITY` — canonical format, rules, and lang-agnostic note defined there.
### Completion Rule (baseline) A task cannot transition to `[x] DONE` until ALL of (per `AX_DONE_REQUIRES_EVIDENCE`): 1. Every phase declared in Phases Overview has Status `[x]`. 2. Every BDD scenario mapped to test ownership in Test Scenario Coverage OR has `Deferred Test Ownership: `. 3. Verification commands relevant to each phase executed; results + exit codes recorded in that phase's Execution Log block. 4. Canonical case names match real test cases or ticket updated. 5. `Deferred Runtime Scope` recorded if applicable. 6. Every introduced-beyond-Inventory entity logged as ` intro ← ` in the relevant phase block. 7. Every phase block ends with a typed **Handoff →** line.
Task-specific additions live in each ticket's Verification section.
### Execution Log Template Canonical token vocabulary (single source of truth; phase-protocol and audit reference this table, do not redefine):
| Token | Tail | Mandatory when | |---|---|---| | `intro` | ` ← ` | new entity appears in code beyond module Entity Inventory | | `decision` | `= ← ` | typed choice that affected output | | `tried` | ` → ` | approach attempted then abandoned (failed path worth recording) | | `discovery` | `` | reality diverged from spec / assumption | | `insight` | ` → , ` | spec gap detected | | `verified` | `@ ` | `config` kind: third-party API confirmed | | `ver` | ` → pass|fail exit=` | once per phase, closing run (always present) | | `BLOCKED` | `` | phase ended `[!] BLOCKED` | | `DONE` | (no tail) | terminal line of phase or Round close (always present) |
Round structure: ```markdown ### Round — ,
#### P1
- [x] `` ver → pass exit=0 - [x] `` DONE **Handoff →** artifacts: [...]; decisions: [...]; open: [...]
#### Round close - [x] `` DONE ```
Trivial phase with no events → 2 lines (`ver` + `DONE`) + Handoff. Padding with empty lines is forbidden.
⛔ `[x]` line with any unreplaced `<…>` literal = fabricated done → `EXECUTION_LOG_INCOMPLETE` (BLOCKER).
### Post-task Hook Per `AX_AUDIT_HOOK`. After last phase of a Round closes, the orchestrator dispatches `sdd-audit`. Until audit returns PASS, Round is closed-but-unverified and dependents are blocked.
